short.en: Manage MikroTik access, diagnostics, and configuration backups from GLPI network equipment records.

long.en:
MikroTik Tools for GLPI adds per-device access actions for WinBox, PuTTY, and WebFig; a Windows installer registers the browser protocol handlers and installs missing clients. It provides GLPI access logs, SSH host fingerprint verification, read-only RouterOS policy and service diagnostics, masked RouterOS .rsc export/import over REST, and sensitive text backup/restore over SSH/SFTP. WebFig prefers WWW-SSL and falls back to WWW. Actions are controlled by GLPI permissions and RouterOS policies.
Version 1.0.2 encrypts router passwords with the GLPI security key, migrates stored plaintext credentials, and adds a per-profile permission matrix for client launch, access logs, credential viewing/editing, diagnostics, and backup/restore. Launch requests are CSRF-protected POSTs with single-use 15-second codes and a live countdown. SSH fingerprint pinning, GLPI database migrations, and client installer URL generation are hardened. PuTTY receives credentials through a per-launch Windows named pipe; KiTTY integration was removed because its password option exposes credentials in process arguments. WinBox automatic login requires the password as a process argument and its native password/session-save settings are outside the plugin's control. GLPI 12.x was tested on GLPI 12.0.2; the earlier stable release was exercised on GLPI 11.0.9. The source is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.
